program_solutions:
(rule!
  (for*/fold ([out g]) ([r (in-range (- (rows g) 1))] [c (in-range (- (cols g) 1))])
    (let ((a (at g r c)) (b (at g r (+ c 1))) (d (at g (+ r 1) c)) (e (at g (+ r 1) (+ c 1))))
      (cond
        [(and (= a 3) (= e 3) (= b 0) (= d 0))
         (set-cell (set-cell out r (+ c 1) 3) (+ r 1) c 3)]
        [(and (= b 3) (= d 3) (= a 0) (= e 0))
         (set-cell (set-cell out r c 3) (+ r 1) (+ c 1) 3)]
        [else out]))))
